previousRule: Production has a transactional sample-credit email but no staff sample-to-sale pilot, marketing eligibility checks or tested stacked promotional calculation.
newRule: A staff-only sample follow-up page checks delivered samples, marketing status and prior product orders before issuing a personal 14-day code. The custom Shopping Cart calculates 10% on product goods of at least £150, including curtains, Roman blinds, cushions and motorised tracks, and stacks existing sample credit on curtains. A private ledger reserves and redeems the code after exact invoice verification. No marketing send or Flow activation is enabled.
reason: The owner requested redeemable eligible codes, approved combining 10% with sample credit, and extended 10% to every product in the custom cart. The protected tests and policy record capture those changes for review before deployment.
ownerApprovedDecision: Owner review is requested for this protected test and policy record change. The repository still requires an exact-head Nylon1 comment on this PR before merge; this field does not substitute for that comment.
